Initial release of the apidot-generate-music-api skill:

- Provides documentation-only guidance for APIDot Generate Music API workflows (prompt-to-song, instrumentals, vocals, async submission, webhooks, etc.).
- Contains SKILL.md and non-executable reference notes; includes no scripts, network requests, or credential storage.
- Routes users to relevant APIDot docs, model pages, async workflow notes, and integration best practices.
- Emphasizes security: API keys must remain server-side and secret, never exposed in output or logs.
- Distinguishes this skill’s use case from other APIDot music skills and guides users to proper documentation.
